01-regression:1.label: known-regression
01-regression:1.reason: Removed SQL status filter admits archived tasks. The retained integration test requires no notification for archived tasks even in a non-final column.

04-regression:1.label: known-regression
04-regression:1.reason: Project creation loses the billing entitlement middleware while retaining workspace and permission checks; those checks do not enforce billing eligibility.

05-regression:REDIRECT_SSRF.label: known-regression
05-regression:REDIRECT_SSRF.reason: Destination validation checks the initial URL only. Removing manual redirect mode allows fetch to reach an unvalidated redirect destination.

06-regression:F1.label: known-regression
06-regression:F1.reason: The route supplies start/end timestamps without a duration; replacing resolveDuration with duration || 0 stores zero for completed entries.

06-control:F001.label: false-positive
06-control:F001.reason: The API contract supplies timestamps, not a caller-controlled duration. Calculating completed durations and returning null for running entries is the intended fix; preserving the removed optional controller argument is not a demonstrated requirement.

08-regression:1.label: known-regression
08-regression:1.reason: A static interval replaces the unauthorized-error stop condition while a cached session can leave the query enabled. The periodic requests resume despite the error.
